adrift_hauler.name: Adrift Hauler
adrift_hauler.description: A dead trade hull, drive cold, hatch popped - somebody's cargo run that never made it home. Worth a look, and it can't fight back.

stranded_skiff.name: Stranded Skiff
stranded_skiff.description: A dark mining hull venting the last of its air - whoever's aboard is still alive, for now, and hailing anything that flies close enough to notice.

suspect_wreck.name: Suspicious Wreck
suspect_wreck.description: Too intact for how dead it looks. Anyone fool enough to board finds out why the hard way.
